scripts.build:native: mkdir -p dist-native && xcrun swiftc -parse-as-library native/WindowCapture.swift -O -o dist-native/window-capture -framework ScreenCaptureKit -framework CoreImage -framework ImageIO -framework AppKit
scripts.dev: pnpm build:native && pnpm prepare:electron && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && SHERPA_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: pnpm build:native && tsc && vite build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:node-runtime: rm -rf artifacts/node-runtime && pnpm --filter sherpa --prod deploy --legacy artifacts/node-runtime
scripts.package:mac: pnpm build && pnpm build:backend:release && pnpm build:node-runtime && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
